title: SWE-2
lede: September 10, 2026. The first SWE model post-trained on a multi-trillion-parameter base — Kimi K3 under the hood, Cognition's refined RL recipe on top — and the first coding model to sit within a single point of the frontier while costing roughly a third as much to run.
body:
## THE HEADLINE
50.0%−64%92.8%
frontiercode 1.1 maincost vs fable 5.1terminal-bench 2.1
50.0% on FrontierCode 1.1 Main — within one point of Fable 5.1, at 64% lower rollout cost. Within a few points of GPT-6 Astra at roughly a quarter of the price. Ahead of its own predecessor SWE-1.7, Grok 4.6, and GPT-5.6 Sol on the comparison table Cognition published. And 92.8% on Terminal-Bench 2.1 — the top of that board. ## HOW IT WAS TRAINED * Base — Kimi K3: the recipe ported onto open weights at multi-trillion-parameter scale. * Recipe — a refinement of the multi-turn RL stack proven on Kevin-32B, SWE-1.5→1.7, scaled to a frontier-size base for the first time. * Objective — jointly optimize capability and cost; the Pareto curve is the target, not a single score. ## EFFORT LEVELS — A FIRST FOR THE FAMILY
effortbehavior
Mediumscores higher than SWE-1.7 while taking 58% fewer turns and costing 81% less
Highmore thinking for harder problems
Maxlearned to spend more tokens and turns to reach the highest scores
The small detail the curators love: on medium effort, SWE-2 makes its first code edit at step 18 where SWE-1.7 waited until step 48 — it explores more deliberately, then commits. Intelligence, in this lineage, is partly the discipline not to touch the keyboard. ## WHERE IT LIVES

Devin CLIavailable day one
Devin Webrolling out
Fusionrolling out
Launch terms: free for Pro, Max, and Teams subscribers for the first month. Benchmark disclosure note, per the lab: each model evaluated in its native harness — Claude Code for Anthropic models, Codex for OpenAI, Grok Build for xAI, Devin CLI for open weights — best score across effort settings. > Our team uses SWE-2 daily in Devin for feature development, debugging, and complex visualizations. — Cognition, September 2026 — the flagship eats its own cooking ## THE LINEAGE
